displayName: stocks: sell/add plan broke an invariant

documentation.content: The /review read built a plan that cannot be right (`review.invariant`): held weights not summing to 1, a target outside 0–1, a move against its own verdict (trim with money in, add with money out), or a sale with no tax while the book replays. The line carries the kind, the bound user and counts only — no tickers. Once per kind and user every 6 hours per instance. Triage: `uv run stocks logs tail --since 24h --event review.invariant --json`, then `uv run stocks logs tail --since 24h --event api.review --json` for the same user to see the book's shape (jurisdiction, base, lenses, unrated causes, phases).
